mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_as_service WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT cs.id AS sessionId, cc.id AS courseClassId, cc.course_class_name AS courseClassName, t.teacher_name AS teacherName, cs.week_day AS weekDay, cs.start_time AS startTime, cs.end_time AS endTime, sp.section_no AS sectionNo, sp.section_name AS sectionName, cc.applicable_class_ids AS applicableClassIds, cc.applicable_grade_ids AS applicableGradeIds, cc.enroll_type AS enrollType FROM t_as_service s INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cc.service_id = s.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_course_session cs ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cs.is_valid = 1 left join t_as_schedule_period sp ON cs.schedule_period_id = sp.id and sp.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_teacher t ON t.id = cc.teacher_id AND t.is_valid = 1 WHERE s.is_valid = 1 AND s.id = #{serviceId} AND cs.session_status != 3 AND cc.class_status in (1,2) GROUP BY cs.course_class_id, cs.week_day, cs.schedule_period_id ORDER BY cs.week_day ASC, sp.section_no ASC, cs.start_time ASC
